changeSet.author: ops
changeSet.comment: One-off: promote the fadloullahi DOVE profile (email fadloullahi14@gmail.com, provisioned via preprod Keycloak) from BUSINESS_USER to ADMIN and grant it global scope.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE dove_resource SET payload = JSON_SET( payload, '$.role', 'ADMIN', '$.accessScope.global', CAST('true' AS JSON) ) WHERE resource_type = 'utilisateurs' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.email')) = 'fadloullahi14@gmail.com';
